independentAssessment.sourceFidelity: One shared frame, all four axial stations, positive end sections, intermediate actual/comparison rims, outer contours, dashed interior rims/generators and section diameters, and the solid two diameters at b are retained. No source point, subfigure, numeric datum, grid, or unit is missing. The station labels are moved below their section guides for clearance, rather than placed over the shared axis.
independentAssessment.mathematics: The later provided figure context establishes the comparison of two equal-height cylinders around a growing slice. Independent coordinate/SVG checks confirm positive ordered stations, matching small and large cylinder radii, equal height x to x+Delta x, increasing body radius bounded by those cylinder radii over the slice, and the b diameter through the section center. The schematic radii are not asserted as source numeric givens.
independentAssessment.labelReview: All ten visible mathematical labels are present and readable. Vector accents and capital delta render coherently; original O-versus-zero and exact source accent typography remain HOLD, not resolved by modern font choices.
independentAssessment.solidDashed: The small a rear rim, interior small-cylinder rims/generators, large comparison rear rims, and a/x/x+Delta x center guides are dashed. Front comparison outlines/generators, body outline, both b rims, and both b diameters are solid. The scan's fine overlaps remain ambiguous rather than supplying new hidden-edge facts.
independentAssessment.readability: All bound desktop/mobile measurements are 22 px at a fixed 640 px SVG, above 16 px. Full desktop shows every label and boundary; no incoherent overlap, lost point, blank/black rendering, or intrinsic-canvas clipping observed.
independentAssessment.mobile: Start shows origin/basis/a/x; end shows x+Delta x/b/right x label. Endpoint x label is partly cut at the left scroll viewport boundary, but complete at start. This is expected viewport clipping, not an unreachable or intrinsically clipped label. End scrollLeft 282 plus clientWidth 358 equals total 640.
independentAssessment.cultural: Neutral mathematical line art and mathematical Latin/symbol labels only. No Cyrillic, Chinese figure text, flags, uniforms, political motifs, historical texture, fictional cultural wording, or answer value leaked.
